description: This file defines the WebSocketChannel class, which implements a transport-independent WebSocket protocol handler, including connection management, frame sending/receiving, and handshake procedures within the Chromium project.

classes.name: WebSocketChannel
classes.description: Transport-independent implementation of WebSockets, managing connection states, data frames, handshakes, and errors.

methods.name: SendAddChannelRequest
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket connection process with specified parameters.

methods.name: SendFrame
methods.description: Sends a data frame to the remote WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: SendAddChannelRequestForTesting
methods.description: Starts connection with a custom callback, used for testing.

methods.name: SetClosingHandshakeTimeoutForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom timeout for the closing handshake, used for testing.

methods.name: SetUnderlyingConnectionCloseTimeoutForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom timeout for connection close, used for testing.

methods.name: OnStartOpeningHandshake
methods.description: Called when the WebSocket opening handshake begins.
